Part of #27377 (wave-3 accuracy, slice S3)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：校准两份 QA 测试清单 JSON（access-security、identity-auth）中 17 个条目的文字，使其与当前代码一致；每条 revision +1，保留 main 的 history 前缀，追加一行引用对应的 QA 运行记录与 #27377。
- 为什么改：wave-3 的五份运行记录（#27392、#27409、#27438、#27441、#27481）实测发现这些条目的步骤、夹具或校验说法已过时（例如数据接口拒绝码在顶层 `code`、Setup 的权限矩阵保存直接生效、身份邮件存于 sys_identity_email）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/` 下两份清单，不动产品代码、不发布；没有任何条款被放宽。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`identity-auth.json` 的 `auth-gate-held-session-raw-host-families` fixtures.requires[1]（原记录行被截断，后半句据源码补全）；`access-security.json` 的 `crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[1]；`fls-mask-and-strip` acceptance[4]（由“缺失或置空”收紧为“键缺失”）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期 `OK — 16 areas, 352 items`，symbol anchors `1068/1078`（基线 1064/1074，新增 4 个锚点全部可解析）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two files, 17 items. Each item's `revision` is +1 from main, main's `history` is kept as an exact prefix, and one row is appended. The row cites the run record the finding came from (`ref`) and the wave anchor #27377 (in `change`). Every STALE row in the census's S3 slice was re-checked against the source at base `efdddc9060` before it was edited. All 17 still held; none had been fixed upstream. No clause is weakened. Where a clause moved at all, it got stronger: fls acceptance[4] now accepts only an absent key, not "absent or nulled".

| item | census row | old → new (brief) | record |
|---|---|---|---|
| access-security.record-share-grant-revoke | 12 | requires[3] / steps[10]: "assign the position … so a created grant is observable" → the `sys_user_position` insert itself materialises the grant (`bindRecipientMembershipRecompute`), so evaluate answers grantsCreated 0. Read the rule-sourced `sys_record_share` row instead | #27392 |
| access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only | 41, 141, 142, 133 (gap) | steps[0] `showcase_member_access` (absent, 404) → `showcase_member_default` (exists). requires[0] adds the shared-checkout boot `objectstack dev --fresh --no-compile -p PORT`. knownGaps[1] added: the install-local leg rests on the wall dogfood pin, and a live leg boots from a scratch copy | #27481 (+#27409) |
| access-security.fls-mask-and-strip | 42 | acceptance[4] / steps[5]: "scratch readable:false grant … absent or nulled" → the stock `showcase_client_liaison` grant; all three keys ABSENT (strip); a nulled key is a FAIL | #27409 |
| access-security.rls-both-sides | 43 | acceptance[4].verify names the adopted-row proof: on stock, showcase_account's derived admin create answers 400, so its proof rides a seeded row (`rls.ts`, the #7685 cascade-stopper). The verdict stands, and the 400 is not an RLS finding | #27409 |
| access-security.crud-permission-matrix | 138, 139 | acceptance[1] / steps[2]: `error.code` → top-level `body.code` (envelope `{error, code, object}`, `mapDataError`). acceptance[6].verify / steps[6]: "16 hand-driven cells" → pinned since r9 by the dogfood case for the 16 delegate cells | #27481 |
| access-security.owd-sharing-matrix | 140 | steps[3]: project create needs status `planned` (`initialStates`, else 400 `invalid_initial_state`). steps[4]: invoice body gains the required `account` (not churned) | #27481 |
| access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop | 125 | steps[2], [4], [5]: "save (draft) then publish" → the Setup editor's Save is a plain PUT that lands active; publish then answers 404 `NO_DRAFT`. Only the package door saves a draft | #27441 |
| identity-auth.two-factor-disable-lifecycle | 16 | acceptance[0].verify: `features.twoFactor` → `data.features.twoFactor`. steps[6], steps[7], acceptance[5].verify: disable and verify-totp rotate the session, so sign in again or carry the echoed token | #27392 |
| identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal | 17 | acceptance[4].verify: the after-verification probes carry the token verify-totp echoes; the pre-verify bearer answers 401 to every probe. steps[1] / acceptance[0]: `data.features.twoFactor` | #27392 |
| identity-auth.first-run-owner-bootstrap | 116 | steps[2], [9]: `/setup` → `/_console/setup`; the login URL becomes `/_console/login?redirect=%2Fsetup` | #27441 |
| identity-auth.self-service-profile-password | 117 | source[2]: reuse prevention applies only when `password_history_count` is above 0, and it defaults to 0 | #27441 |
| identity-auth.default-organization-boot-invariant | 142 | requires[0] adds the shared-checkout `--no-compile` boot and keeps `--log-level info` | #27481 |
| identity-auth.api-key-expiry-lifecycle | 183 | acceptance[2].verify: count keys with `GET /api/v1/data/sys_api_key`, not `GET /api/v1/keys`, which is refusal-only and answers 405 | #27438 |
| identity-auth.import-invitation-and-sso-domain-answers | 184 | requires[1]: "boot log mail capture" → read `sys_identity_email`; LogTransport logs no body or link | #27438 |
| identity-auth.implicit-account-linking-ownership | 185 | requires[2]: the verify-email link is in `sys_identity_email`, not `sys_email` | #27438 |
| identity-auth.auth-method-matrix | 186 | knownGaps[3]: "needs a reachable external IdP" → SSO register refuses a loopback IdP with 400 `discovery_private_host` unless it is in trustedOrigins, so the localhost OIDC IdP does not unblock `features.sso` | #27438 |
| identity-auth.auth-gate-held-session-raw-host-families | 187 | requires[1]: "an expiry / MFA policy holds it" → PASSWORD_EXPIRED needs `password_expiry_days` above 0 and an aged `password_changed_at`; MFA_REQUIRED waits out `mfa_grace_period_days` (default 7). Set it to 0 or age the stamp | #27438 |
| identity-auth.two-factor-verify-to-activate + identity-auth.two-factor-backup-codes | S3 report out_of_scope_findings[1] (seat fold-in) | steps[0] / acceptance[0].verify (verify-to-activate) and acceptance[0].clause (backup-codes): the /auth/config guard `features.twoFactor` → `data.features.twoFactor` (the body is {success, data}); source[] symbol lines unchanged | #27377 |

## Tests

None. The diff is ledger text in `docs/qa/`, so no package test reads it. The structural pin is `check:platform-checklist`. A shape check run in a scratch directory compared every item in both files against main. Exactly 17 items differ. Each has revision = main + 1, main's history as an exact prefix, and one appended `{revision, date, change, ref}` row whose `ref` is one of the five records and whose `change` cites #27377. The other 49 items are byte-equal as parsed JSON, and item ids and order are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope, declared.** In some items the same stale fact also sat beside the named clause, and leaving it would have made the item contradict itself. Those copies are corrected here too:
  - crud-permission-matrix acceptance[6]'s "only these are judged by the dogfood pin";
  - permission-matrix-edit-loop steps[4] and [5];
  - two-factor-enrollment-reveal steps[1] and acceptance[0] (`data.features.twoFactor`);
  - two-factor-disable-lifecycle steps[6];
  - first-run-owner-bootstrap steps[9]'s login URL.

  first-run acceptance[5]'s router-relative `/login?redirect=%2Fsetup` is still true and is left as is.
- **Not driven live by this slice.** Every edit rests on two things: the run record's measurement, and a source read at `efdddc9060`. Each history row says so. The auth-gate finding line in anchor comment 6494110310 is truncated after "require_mfa alone holds nobody for a week". Its remainder (set the grace to 0, or age the stamp) is read from `resolveUserAuthGates` and the auth settings manifest.
- **Family, not edited here:**
  - The boot string `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT --seed-admin` sits in `fixtures.requires` of 39 items across 14 area files. Only the two items the finding named are edited. The shared-checkout `--no-compile` rule would land once in RUNNER.md more cheaply than as 37 more item edits. carrier: the seat (S8 / RUNNER).
  - `two-factor-verify-to-activate` and `two-factor-backup-codes`: resolved in this PR (seat fold-in at `21209eeb3e`, row in the table above).
- **Parked GAP rows (census), untouched:**
  - rls-both-sides acceptance[5] D11 (rows 23, 130);
  - crud-permission-matrix acceptance[5] (rows 24, 131);
  - fls-mask-and-strip maskingRule half (row 25);
  - public-form-withdrawal-layers A2–A5 (row 26);
  - auth-method-matrix device / login-UI gap (row 149).

  Row 133 (walled install-local, "Recipe yes") is closed as a knownGaps line, which is a pure fixture-text edit.
- **Held or UNCLEAR census items:** none sits in these two files, so nothing here was skipped by order.
- **No product defect found.** The rls derived-body 400 is the verify sweep's designed adopt fallback. The 405 on `GET /keys` is the ledgered refusal-only mount.
